description: dc_capacity removed. The module declares it required (it is what makes the document a data center), so MOD-SECTION-MISSING is an error naming the module that asked. Every calc that reads capacity degrades to null rather than throwing, and the six capacity rules fall silent. CC-MOD-DC-07 still fires: rent_index reads dc_revenue alone, and one missing section does not suppress findings about the sections that are present.
